name: EPIC 212545314

text.card: A red giant 2,664 parsecs away, 18 times the Sun's width, weighed by its starquakes.
text.introduction: Its oscillations, recorded in K2 campaign 6, give 0.86 solar masses and 18.0 solar radii; APOGEE spectra give 4,696 K at its surface.
